_meta.versions_note: Populated on 2026-08-25 by scripts/capture_mcp.py from real MCP responses. Nothing here is invented: every version id was returned by get_workflow_details (or, for a published body, get_workflow_version), and every hash is sha256 over sync.canonical_json() of the scrubbed body that sits in exports/. A workflow's draft/published state is live, so these are the values as at 2026-08-25 and they age.
_meta.sync_direction: n8n -> GitHub only. GitHub never writes to n8n.
